paragraphs.text:
Huge, ape-like figures—at least a score of them! They appear 
excited, waving clubs and rocks in their huge paws. Hemmed 
in the gully, you feel very vulnerable.
To fire a shot to scare them off, go to 346. To remain calm, go to 348.
